name: health
description: Health The Health API provides access to the Health information that appears in the Health Dashboard.

subcommands.name: describe-affected-accounts-for-organization
subcommands.description: Returns a list of accounts in the organization from Organizations that are affected by the provided event.

subcommands.name: describe-affected-entities
subcommands.description: Returns a list of entities that have been affected by the specified events, based on the specified filter criteria.

subcommands.name: describe-affected-entities-for-organization
subcommands.description: Returns a list of entities that have been affected by one or more events for one or more accounts in your organization in Organizations, based on the filter criteria.

subcommands.name: describe-entity-aggregates
subcommands.description: Returns the number of entities that are affected by each of the specified events.

subcommands.name: describe-entity-aggregates-for-organization
subcommands.description: Returns a list of entity aggregates for your Organizations that are affected by each of the specified events.

subcommands.name: describe-event-aggregates
subcommands.description: Returns the number of events of each event type (issue, scheduled change, and account notification).

subcommands.name: describe-event-details
subcommands.description: Returns detailed information about one or more specified events.

subcommands.name: describe-event-details-for-organization
subcommands.description: Returns detailed information about one or more specified events for one or more Amazon Web Services accounts in your organization.

subcommands.name: describe-event-types
subcommands.description: Returns the event types that meet the specified filter criteria.

subcommands.name: describe-events
subcommands.description: Returns information about events that meet the specified filter criteria.

subcommands.name: describe-events-for-organization
subcommands.description: Returns information about events across your organization in Organizations.

subcommands.name: describe-health-service-status-for-organization
subcommands.description: This operation provides status information on enabling or disabling Health to work with your organization.

subcommands.name: disable-health-service-access-for-organization
subcommands.description: Disables Health from working with Organizations.

subcommands.name: enable-health-service-access-for-organization
subcommands.description: Enables Health to work with Organizations.
